description: goo 2026-07-29 (harness ปิดวง, PR-2 pre-push hook): client-side .githooks/pre-push + scripts/install-git-hooks.sh (core.hooksPath) refuse an ACCIDENTAL direct push to the repo's protected branch — the ชั้น-3 หยุด layer complementing PR-1's server-side tripwire. Bug-class the anchor owns: a push whose remote ref targets the protected (default) branch slipping through, OR the guard mis-identifying which branch is protected. The protected branch is READ FROM GIT (git symbolic-ref refs/remotes/origin/HEAD → main here, pdf-dev in bazi), never hardcoded, so the one hook is correct per-repo. Teeth run the REAL shell hook via execSync against HERMETIC sandbox repos the test builds itself (each with a controlled origin/HEAD → env-independent, does NOT read the ambient checkout's refs; first version read ambient origin/HEAD and crashed in CI where it is unset — a verify-real-path miss, refactored hermetic): npx tsx scripts/pre-push-guard.test.ts 8/8 — protected-branch push BLOCKED (exit 1, done-condition 1), feature-branch push ALLOWED (exit 0, done-condition 2), protected-mixed-with-allowed BLOCKED, protected-branch delete (0-oid) BLOCKED, empty push allowed, a feature branch merely CONTAINING the protected name (feat/main-ish) ALLOWED (exact-match not substring), a bazi-style sandbox (protected=pdf-dev) BLOCKS pdf-dev but ALLOWS main (read per-repo from git, not hardcoded), and no-origin/HEAD sandbox fails OPEN (exit 0). HONEST SCOPE (stated in hook + docs/git-hooks.md + evidence, not papered): catches 'เผลอ push main' only; git push --no-verify bypasses all hooks; runs only where the installer ran; fail-OPEN if the default branch can't be determined. Install once (absolute hooksPath to the main checkout, shared via .git/config) covers every worktree existing+future. gate_layer=git-hook/client-side-guard.
